name: Pipe racks, sleepers and pipe supports
principle: Pipe racks carry interconnecting piping in tiers along roads and unit boundaries; individual supports (shoes, guides, anchors, spring and constant-effort hangers) carry the pipe's own loads while allowing thermal movement. Rack design ties together pipe stress needs (support spacing, guide positions), civil loads (wind, seismic, friction), and constructability (splice points, tier heights). Expansion loops, guides and anchors are positioned from stress analysis, not civil preference.

process_steps.name: Piping routed; rack width, tiers and elevations set
Rack structure designed for piping, wind, seismic and friction loads
Support types selected and located with the pipe stress results
Support details and spring settings issued and inspected

limitations: support locations are negotiated between stress and civil every project; late moves are expensive
corrosion under supports is a known integrity hotspot on aging racks
advantages: routable, inspectable, upgradable utility spine for the plant
standardised supports make thousands of points designable in weeks
